about: Brand Intelligence connections, read on Nov 16 2026 from public Adobe pages: Brand validation with Adobe Brand Intelligence and Firefly Creative Production for Enterprise (business.adobe.com), and the Adobe Brand Intelligence overview and Instruct to Assemble (helpx.adobe.com). Each connection keeps the quote on its source page and the references behind it. Hours are our own estimates; Adobe publishes none. Nov 17 2026 (Adam: "yes for both"): Brand Intelligence + Creative Cloud and Brand Intelligence + Coworker, native and with no services of their own, both on the Brand validation page: its Native integrations line names Photoshop, and its answer to "Where can Adobe Brand Intelligence Validate be used?", read from the owner's screenshot of the page, names "AI chat surfaces such as Adobe CX Coworker". Adobe's November 10 news line on Coworker and Brand Intelligence is a reference on the Coworker one.

connections.how: Instruct to Assemble runs in Figma through the Adobe Brand Intelligence plugin. The user picks a context, such as channel, audience and product data, and the number of variants, and Brand Intelligence assembles on-brand variants from predefined templates and brand guidelines, selecting and cropping images and validating the output against brand compliance rules.

connections.source_quote: You can use Instruct to assemble in Figma via the Adobe Brand Intelligence plugin to quickly create multiple on-brand variants using predefined templates and brand guidelines.

gain.text: Your client's team creates multiple on-brand variants in Figma from predefined templates, with image selection, cropping and brand checks handled automatically, which reduces manual effort in selecting and assembling assets.

connections.how: Adobe's Brand validation page says the Validate skill is available in "AI chat surfaces such as Adobe CX Coworker". Adobe's news says "CX Enterprise Coworker draws on Adobe Brand Intelligence to bring business and brand context into agent-led workflows".

source.title: Adobe for Business: Brand validation with Adobe Brand Intelligence

connections.source_quote: The Adobe Brand Intelligence Validate skill is available in creative surfaces such as Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign; review and approval surfaces such as Adobe Workfront and Frame.io for Business; and AI chat surfaces such as Adobe CX Coworker. APIs also let organizations bring brand validation into third-party applications and custom workflows, extending brand checks beyond native Adobe integrations.
